blocking.note: Silent authorization bypass (OWASP A01:2021 / CWE-863): getAuthorizationService() returns null on Throwable, and the entire REQUIRED_ROLES check is guarded by nullable — any authenticated user can advance decisions through the full approval chain when AuthorizationService is unavailable

Reviewer impersonation (OWASP A01:2021 / CWE-639): personId is taken from the POST body at line 120 without verifying the authenticated Nextcloud user corresponds to that Person entity — any authenticated user can forge sign-offs on behalf of any person in the system
